title: Fixed createDb config mutation bug
content: What: createDb was mutating global config — calling createDb for a test DB would overwrite the cached singleton config. Why: Tests creating isolated DBs were breaking the main DB's config. Where: db.js createDb function. Learned: Always save and restore config around createDb calls. The fix adds config isolation via save/restore of getConfig._cached.

title: createDb config isolation pattern
content: What: createDb uses a save/restore pattern for config isolation. The function saves the current config state, creates the new DB, and restores the original config on error. Why: Prevents test DBs from polluting the main DB's config. Where: db.js. Learned: The save/restore happens around the createDb call and is critical for test isolation. On success, config is NOT auto-restored so callers can continue using the isolated DB.
